subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face having ‘2’. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6eaf57f2e6dcffa02d4ff4e88330c55624cfbf3369c8eacd65866567e2dd7e8.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '2', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a7503bb083e8cee3631e9de8b6b13de8ec852a54e99aed05523a7a0fe80986e.png] 

From both dices, 4 is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

1 is opposite to 3.

6 is opposite to 5.

So, 4 will be opposite to 2.

Hence, the correct answer is "4".
